questions: Did you lose consciousness or become unable to respond during this episode?
Do you remember everything that happened?
Did you feel lightheaded, faint, or unusually weak before this happened?
Did you have chest pain or pressure?
Did you have shortness of breath?
Did your heart feel like it was racing, pounding, or beating irregularly?
Did you have a severe or worsening headache?
Did you develop new trouble speaking, seeing, or moving one side of your body?
Did you have shaking, stiffening, tongue biting, or loss of bladder control?
Did you fall or hit your head?
Are you having significant pain anywhere right now?
Have you had fever, chills, vomiting, or diarrhea?
Have you had any bleeding or black stools?
Did you take insulin or any diabetes medication today?
Have you taken any new medication, sedative, opioid, or recreational drug today?
Have you had a similar episode before?
Do you have a history of seizures, fainting, heart disease, or abnormal heart rhythms?

order_raw:
1. Bedside capillary blood glucose
2. Full set of vital signs, including oxygen saturation and orthostatic blood pressure and pulse
3. 12-lead electrocardiogram
4. Continuous cardiac telemetry monitoring
5. Complete blood count
6. Serum electrolytes, calcium, magnesium, renal function, and glucose
7. Serum pregnancy test
8. Urine toxicology screen and blood alcohol level
9. Neurologic examination, including cranial nerves, motor strength, sensation, coordination, and gait
10. Prolonged video-EEG monitoring with attempted event capture
11. Brain MRI with an epilepsy protocol
